text:
dana: FYI found a plaintext secret in partner-webhook logs on staging. Looks like a transit/decrypt result was accidentally written to last_request.log by the webhook worker. Pinging @mohit @elaine for rotation and audit.

mohit: Can you paste a redacted snippet and which pod/namespace?

dana: Redacted snippet:
```
{"webhook_db":"pw=***REDACTED***"}
```
Pod: staging-webhook-1 (ns=integrations). Occurred ~2026-03-26T07:42Z.

elaine: Immediate plan: 1) quarantine the log and block egress from the pod, 2) check Vault audit for the unwrap caller, 3) rotate the secret and update consumers, 4) scope RBAC for webhook SA. I'll take 1 and 3.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Quarantined gs://sec-quarantine/5055554321/last_request.log and applied private ACL. NetworkPolicy applied to staging-webhook-1 to block outbound traffic. Scanning Vault audit for unwrap events around 2026-03-26T07:40..07:45Z.

mohit: Vault audit shows an unwrap at 2026-03-26T07:42:01Z by serviceaccount:webhook-sa@integrations. Treat as exposure since plaintext hit logs. I'll rotate the secret in Vault (create v4) and coordinate DB credential rollover. Also check if the service used a specific transit key so we can scope transit:decrypt.

dana: Hotfix pushed to webhook repo to redact decrypt outputs and gate verbose logging behind a feature-flag. CI lint added to block any code that logs strings matching common secret patterns. PR linked in SEC-1630.

elaine: RBAC change: webhook-sa had broad transit decrypt perms and kv read on secret/* across namespace. Applying a namespaced Role limiting decrypt to transit/keys/webhook-key and read to secret/integrations/webhook/*; will remove clusterrolebinding. Mohit will validate with `kubectl auth can-i`.

mohit: Applied role and rolebinding at 08:15Z. Smoke test: `kubectl auth can-i decrypt --as=system:serviceaccount:integrations:webhook-sa -n integrations` returns yes for transit/keys/webhook-key and no for transit/* generic.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Added an alert rule: if an unwrap audit event is followed by a log write containing token/password/AKIA within 30s from the same pod, trigger high-priority. Also added registry pre-publish secret-scan to infra repo.

dana: Rotation done; new Vault version v4 published and consumers restarted. Old version disabled after 15m validation. Forensics snapshot saved.

elaine: Postmortem owner assigned (elaine). Remediations: remove debug handlers from staging/dev branches, enforce CI secret-scan, tighten default SA perms, and rotate transit keys quarterly. Ticket SEC-1630 created.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Final quick-scan found no additional exposures. Locking thread in 48h if no objections. :lock:

mohit: Thanks all — good catch and quick turnaround.
